title: Nehru Memorial Museum & Library, Delhi – History, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Nehru Memorial Museum - Delhi,

The Nehru Memorial Museum & Library (NMML), located in Teen Murti Bhavan, Delhi, is a place that takes you back to the life and times of Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, India’s first Prime Minister. Originally built as the official residence of the British Commander-in-Chief, this grand colonial-era building became Nehru’s residence after independence.

Inside the museum, you will find photographs, personal belongings, rare documents, and books that highlight Nehru’s role in shaping modern India. The library here is one of the most important research centers on modern Indian history, with thousands of books, letters, and papers. Walking through the museum feels like stepping into history, where you can see how India’s political journey was shaped.

The museum’s lush green lawns and peaceful surroundings make it not just a place of learning but also a quiet retreat in the heart of Delhi.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Teen Murti Bhavan, Teen Murti Marg, New Delhi,
  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Closed on Mondays and National Holidays),
  • Entry Fee: Free for general visitors,
  • Parking: Paid parking is available near the entrance,

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: The nearest metro station is Lok Kalyan Marg (Yellow Line), around 2 km away.
  • By Bus: DTC buses and private buses stop at Teen Murti Marg.
  • By Auto/Taxi: Easily accessible from all parts of Delhi via cabs and auto-rickshaws.

Best Time to Visit: The museum can be visited throughout the year, but October to March is the most comfortable season due to pleasant weather.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • India Gate - A war memorial and one of Delhi’s most famous landmarks.
  • Rashtrapati Bhavan - The official residence of the President of India.
  • National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) - A must-visit for art lovers.

Travel Tip: Carry a notebook or use your phone to jot down insights - this museum is a treasure trove for history and politics enthusiasts.
excerpt: The Nehru Memorial Museum & Library at Teen Murti Bhavan in Delhi is a must-visit for history lovers. Once the residence of India’s first Prime Minister, it now showcases his life, legacy, and India’s journey after independence. With its rich collection of books, photographs, and artifacts, it’s a great place to explore and learn.

faqs.question: What is special about Nehru Memorial Museum in Delhi?
faqs.answer: It preserves the life and legacy of Jawaharlal Nehru with personal items, rare photographs, and important historical records.

faqs.question: What are the timings of Nehru Memorial Museum?
faqs.answer: The museum is open from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, closed on Mondays and national holidays.

faqs.question: Entry fee for Nehru Memorial Museum?
faqs.answer: No, entry is free for all visitors.

faqs.question: How to reach Nehru Memorial Museum by metro?
faqs.answer: You can get down at Lok Kalyan Marg Metro Station (Yellow Line) and take an auto or taxi to reach the museum.

faqs.question: What are the main attractions inside Nehru Memorial Museum?
faqs.answer: Visitors can explore Nehru’s study room, personal belongings, photographs, and the vast library holding rare documents and books.
